apiMessages.content: My quads are wrecked from Sunday’s leg day — sore going down stairs, nothing sharp and nothing in the joints. Should I still do tomorrow’s upper session?

Yes, go. DOMS in the quads, no joint involvement, nothing sharp — that's normal fatigue, not a reason to skip an upper-body day. Legs aren't loaded tomorrow anyway. Just walk/move a bit beforehand to loosen up.
